name: CADS (conditioning noise, ppm)
plain: Adds noise to conditioning tensors in a sigma window for more variety, then restores the mean and std. Runs before calc_cond_batch and works on c_concat and c_crossattn.

providers.author: pamparamm
providers.note: Rescale fixed on; mean/std reduced over non-batch dims without keepdim (broadcast only clean for batch 1, inference)

providers.author: Clybius
providers.note: add_cads_noise: with cads_rescale factor blend, and custom noise types; timestep-based schedule
